title: osf review run: lens-driven agent review pipeline
summary: Adds `osf review run`, a subcommand that selects review lenses for a change, assembles a redacted context per lens, runs coding-agent harnesses from a shipped roster, verifies every quoted finding against the files, reduces the answers to a verdict, journals each answer and the decision, and can post the kept findings to a pull request. Alongside it, `scan` gains a `scan-secret` rule and suppression-marker support, and a new workflow runs the review from the base branch with the pull request tree mounted read-only.

nodes.label: review_run::run
nodes.summary: Orchestrates one review: loads the catalogue, assesses risk, selects lenses, runs reviewers per lens, journals answers and the decision, and returns the verdict.

nodes.label: lens catalogue
nodes.subtitle: 20 shipped lenses
nodes.summary: Loads shipped, organisation and repository lenses, and selects the ones a change earns by run mode, trigger paths and trigger signals.

nodes.label: review_context::build
nodes.summary: Assembles the diff at the tier's depth plus declared inputs, redacts secrets through the scan rules, and caps the result at 60 kB.

nodes.label: reviewers::run_one
nodes.summary: Runs one harness with an allow-listed environment, a timeout and a tree-kill, then validates its answer, retrying once.

nodes.label: answer validation
nodes.summary: Parses a harness's final message as JSON or from its fenced blocks, validates against the review-answer schema, and checks lens and criterion coverage.

nodes.label: quotes::check
nodes.summary: Verifies each finding's quote against the file and line it names, and is the only way to build a VerifiedAnswer.

nodes.label: reducer::decide
nodes.summary: Turns verified answers into a per-lens verdict by family quorum and blocker veto, then a weighted whole-review verdict against the threshold.

nodes.label: builder::detect
nodes.summary: Reads Code-Generator trailers across the reviewed range and maps model names to families, so a builder's own family is left out of the roster.

nodes.label: risk::assess
nodes.summary: Now also reads diff content to emit trigger signals and takes a separate config root.

nodes.label: scan rules
nodes.summary: Adds the scan-secret rule for token shapes and PEM blocks, and exposes rule_ids for the suppression engine.

nodes.label: suppression engine
nodes.summary: apply_suppressions now takes known rules and owned rules separately, so a marker naming another checker's rule is neither suppressing nor reported unused.

nodes.label: codex

nodes.label: dsh

edges.label: Request
edges.summary: The subcommand builds a Request and calls review_run::run.
Loads the catalogue and selects the lenses the change earns.
Assesses the change for tier and trigger signals.
Detects the builder families to leave out of the roster.
Builds each selected lens's prompt context.
Runs each enabled reviewer for each selected lens.
Checks every answered finding's quote against the files.
Reduces the verified answers to a per-lens and whole-review verdict.
Appends one review-answer event per attempt and one review-decision event.
Reads the roster, threshold and timeout from the trusted config root.
Starts the harness with an allow-listed environment and a timeout.
Starts the harness and reads the answer from its envelope pointer.
Runs the scan rules over the assembled context to redact secrets before any reviewer sees it.
Reads the diff, sibling files and declared inputs from the repository.
Reads the file each finding names to confirm the quote is really there.
Scan findings now pass through the suppression engine with scan's own owned rules.
--no-suppress bypasses the suppression engine entirely.

edges.label: docker run
edges.summary: The workflow builds osf from the base branch and runs it against the read-only pull request tree.
The pre-push task runs the review with --if-enabled --warn-only.

edges.label: --post-to
edges.summary: Posts the kept findings as one review through the existing posting machinery.

flows.title: One review run, from diff to verdict
flows.summary: How a change becomes a verdict: lens selection, context assembly, reviewer rounds, quote verification, reduction and journalling.

messages.label: select(changed, signals, tier)
messages.note: A lens runs when it is always-on, always-at-high-tier on a high tier, or when a changed path or earned signal matches its trigger.

messages.label: build(lens, depth, sources)
messages.note: The diff at the tier's depth plus declared inputs, redacted through the scan rules and capped at 60 kB.

messages.label: run_one(reviewer, prompt, lens, timeout)
messages.note: Each non-builder family gets two rounds; a lone available family gets one extra critical round under the interim policy.

messages.label: check(root, answer)
messages.note: Every finding's quote must be found within two lines of the line it names, or it is dropped.

messages.label: decide_lens(lens, answers, single_family_available)
messages.note: Two distinct families must answer, unless the roster only ever offered one; a blocker or must-fix finding vetoes the lens.

messages.label: decide(lenses, threshold)
messages.note: Any could-not-run lens makes the whole review could-not-run; otherwise a failed lens or a weighted mean under the threshold fails it.

messages.label: ReviewAnswer per attempt
messages.note: One event per reviewer attempt, carrying scores, kept and dropped counts, and the round number; never a prompt or raw answer.

messages.label: ReviewDecision
messages.note: The whole review's verdict, per-lens outcomes, weighted score and threshold, and the detected builder families.

views.title: One review run
views.summary: The ordered steps of a single review run, from lens selection to the journalled decision.

steps.heading: Two ways in
steps.body: CI runs the review from the base branch; the pre-push task runs it warn-only.

steps.heading: Lenses are selected
steps.body: Risk signals and changed paths pick which of the twenty lenses this change earns.

steps.heading: Context is redacted
steps.body: The diff and declared inputs are assembled, secrets redacted, and the result capped.

steps.heading: Harnesses answer
steps.body: Each non-builder family runs its rounds; a builder's own family is left out.

steps.heading: Quotes are checked
steps.body: A finding survives only if its quoted text is really at the file and line it names.

steps.heading: A verdict is reached
steps.body: Family quorum and blocker veto decide each lens, then the weighted mean decides the review.

steps.heading: Everything is journalled
steps.body: Each answer and the decision are appended, with no prompt or raw answer text.
